name: Drag a template from the asset panel into the viewport
body:
# Drag to place

Dragging a template thumbnail over the viewport and releasing adds the entity where the pointer points
(`editorAddEntityAt(template, x, y)`), with the template's lift and snapping applied. Uses Chaos's drag-and-drop with
the viewport as the drop target.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. AssetCard dragPayload template:<id>; the level viewport's onDrop calls lantern_editor_add_entity_at_cursor. Add to world adds at the camera focus.
